name: Nxera Pharma Co., Ltd.
summary: Nxera Pharma Co., Ltd. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, engages in drug discovery and development in Japan, the United States, Germany, Switzerland, Bermuda, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company offers NxWave, a GPCR-targeted structure-based drug discovery platform; PIVLAZ for the cerebral vasospasm, vasospasm-related cerebral infarction, and cerebral ischemic symptoms after aSAH; and QUVIVIQ for insomnia.
